text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan! What's wrong?
Making a face like that...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
Sorry. I just had to ask you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Lately, regarding supporting Kura-chan...
I heard you've been studying to be a Trainer or something. Um...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Could that be for the sake of your family?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan not being able to debut this year, and her decision to support Cla-chan from behind the scenes...
It's all—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If you ended up like that just because of what the grown-ups said,
then I'll...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm not that weak of a girl, you know.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I decided everything myself.
That I would make this year "my" year of preparation.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I haven't reached my "blooming period" yet...
that growth spurt for an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "So if we keep preparing for your debut like this, it'll surely put too much strain on your body. The risk of injury will only go up."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I want to dedicate the rest of this year
to thinking about what to do next year.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So Kita-chan, go ahead and run with Kura-chan.
I promise I'll—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —Because I'll overtake them.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Let's do our best again today!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. Dia's greetings are always so refreshing. Now then... Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: So today's training is for the Tokyo Sports Hai, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Among those, it was gate-break practice, right!
Um, let me get the starting gates ready...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
! Dia, about that...
There's no need to prepare a gate.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "It's gate practice, but it's not start dash practice," you see.
choice_data_list: Diamond, do you know what makes the Tokyo Sports Hai special?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Umm. If we're talking distance and course,
it's the Tokyo Turf 1800m
where Kura-chan ran her debut race, right?
choice_data_list: So, what did you think after watching the debut race?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Right after the start, it felt quite
hectic for a while. But once we reached
the backstretch, the pace started to ease up...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Right! That's the key feature of the Tokyo Turf 1800m!
The starting position is a bit unique!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
On an ordinary course, after starting, you run along
the straight for a bit before entering the corner, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
“Still, the Tokyo Turf 1800m layout
has you entering the second corner right after the start!”

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That's why how you run right from the start
all the way into the first corner
is the key point on this course.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"In the early stages where you want to pick up speed,
do you accelerate knowing the centrifugal force will hit you,
or hold back to avoid the risk?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I see... Because the turn comes up so quickly,
the tactical interplay becomes completely different from a straight stretch, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! You go through all sorts of inner conflicts.
"I want to secure a good position before the backstretch!"
"But if I push the speed too much, will I swing wide?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"How we tackle that will be the key.
That's why—..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —...Or maybe I could run like this!!
(Dadadada!!)

Satono Crown breaks into a clean sprint,
leaning her center of gravity to the left.
choice_data_list: Cut into the corners even sharper!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...! So fast...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: However, for a simulation of the first corner, aren't you going far too fast? ...You won't be able to last until the end.
choice_data_list: Right, you don't need to carry that.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh.
choice_data_list: This running style is only for the beginning, okay?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
! I see. 'Starting practice'...
We can separately review the pacing after that—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...I've learned a lot.
And then came the day of the Tokyo Sports Hai Junior Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kura-chan!
The first corner is where the race will be decided!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, alright, alright.
I understand, Sub-Trainer Dia.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Trainer, give me the strategy instructions.

I go over our strategy once more with Satono Crown,
who is as relaxed and composed as ever,
even before a graded race.
She is dependable—perhaps even too dependable.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Phew—...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Let's build this up piece by piece.
To bring us closer to Satono's long-cherished dream,
and to push beyond even that.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (――...I will win.)
